text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  run-nra:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      nova_request_app_ci_status: ${{ steps.run_nra.outputs.nova_request_app_ci_status }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Erlang
        uses: erlang/actions/setup@v1
        with:
          otp-version: "24"

      - name: Run nova_request_app CI
        id: run_nra
        uses: novaframework/nova_request_app/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main
        with:
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
          nova_repo: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name || github.repository }}

  check-fork-pr:
    needs: run-nra
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify nova_request_app CI passed
        run: |
          echo "nova_request_app CI status: ${{ needs.run-nra.outputs.nova_request_app_ci_status }}"
          if [[ ${{ needs.run-nra.outputs.nova_request_app_ci_status }} != "success" ]]; then
            echo "::error::nova_request_app CI failed"
            exit 1
          fi
```
